description: Cut the main subject out of a photo and make the background transparent (on-device AI — the image never leaves this computer). Saves a transparent PNG and returns its path plus a small preview. Use for "remove the background", "cut out", "transparent background", "누끼", product and profile photos. The PNG is lossless and large; to make it smaller, pass it to `compress` with format webp or png (jpeg cannot be transparent). The first call downloads a ~98 MB model once.

input_path.description: Image file to process (jpg, png, webp, avif, gif, tiff; heic on macOS). Absolute, ~/…, or relative to the working directory.

output_path.description: Where to save the PNG. Default: "<name>-cutout.png" next to the input. Existing files are never overwritten.

name: remove_background
title: Remove background
